Halve or double every image, or keep one level of detail.

down: Gaussian smoothing then half the size, per level (pyrDown); up: double the size, per level (pyrUp); detail: the Laplacian level (the image minus its smoothed copy) at level - 1 halvings, stored around mid-grey (128 = no detail). Done once when the images are prepared: OpenCV on the CPU workers, in canvas order with the other steps done once; every epoch reads the result. Same result in training, validation and test.

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Image Pyramid is a training image step done once when the images are prepared: OpenCV on the CPU workers; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize -> Image Pyramid (down) -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
Done once when the images are prepared (OpenCV, CPU), in canvas order before the first random step. Runs in training, validation and test.
```

## Tips

- down: a quarter of the pixels with less aliasing than a plain resize.
- detail: edges and texture only, mid-grey where flat.
